{
  "name": "token-usage",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A Claude Code mod that draws a band above the prompt with the whole session's prompt cache reads and writes, token usage, cost and subscription rate limits.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Evaldo Klock"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ejklock/claude-usage-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/ejklock/claude-usage-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "plugin",
    "usage",
    "tokens",
    "prompt-cache",
    "cost",
    "rate-limit",
    "statusline"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "locale": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Locale",
      "description": "Language and number format of the usage band.",
      "default": "en",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "pt-BR"
      ]
    },
    "show": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Show",
      "description": "Show each bar and percent as the share used or as the share left.",
      "default": "used",
      "options": [
        "used",
        "left"
      ]
    }
  }
}
